verdict.rationale: Channel3 is API-first: its core capabilities (text, image and URL search, filters, structured product lookup, price-tracking webhooks, agentic search) are all documented as API features, and the SDK, CLI and MCP all call that API. However, no evidence states that the API matches the UI, and account-side actions such as creating API keys, billing and dashboard features are not shown to be available through it. No OpenAPI spec was found to confirm coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of account, key and billing management, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
